items.title: Commencement
notes:
A meeting of City Council was held at 2:07 p.m. this date, chaired by Mayor B. Vrbanovic. Notice of this meeting had been previously given to all members of Council by the City Clerk pursuant to Chapter 25 (Council Procedure) of the Municipal Code.

Councillor A. Owodunni entered the meeting at this time.

The meeting began with a Land Acknowledgement given by the Mayor.

items.title: Disclosure of Pecuniary Interest and the General Nature Thereof
Mayoral Business and Updates - Mayor B. Vrbanovic
To confirm all actions and proceedings of the Council for March 30, 2026.
Adjournment
notes: On motion the meeting adjourned at 2:08 p.m.

motions.text: "That an in-camera meeting of City Council be held immediately following the special council meeting this date to consider three matters one security of property and education matter, one security of property and position/procedure to be applied to negotiations and a potential litigation matter as authorized by Sections 239 (2) (a) (e) (k) and (3.1) of the Municipal Act, 2001, respectively."
